Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Plugins: `extensions/*`; keep plugin-only deps in the extension `package.json`; do not add them to the root `package.json` unless core uses them.

Always consider **all** built-in + extension channels when refactoring shared logic (routing, allowlists, pairing, command gating, onboarding, docs). Core: `docs/channels/`, `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; extensions: `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Docs use Mintlify (docs.clawd.bot). Links in `docs/**/*.md`: root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; cross-references use anchors. When Peter asks for links, reply with full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. When you touch docs, end the reply with the `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs you referenced. README links stay
